title: Certify support obstructions for source-consuming productive helpers
body:
A source-consuming encoder appears to lower native input34 from a five-dimensional chart to `span(73)`. This package proves that its required scalar map cannot feed the proposed retained suffix using ascending paid transports. **No improved kappa or new physical supplier is claimed.**

The strongest obstruction is one main coefficient: `H[51,51]=1/2`, input51 carries direction100, and the greatest suffix cap at output51 is `span(45,76)`, excluding100. A13-edge paid path to fixed main114 independently certifies the exclusion. This rules out every ascending pure-scalar implementation of the nominated whole-encoder map, regardless of cold basis, upfront preparation or interleaved compensation.

A complementary exact identity, `alpha = -D^-1[:,78] + (1/2)D^-1[:,431]` on the cold coordinates, explains the failure of the original compensation proposal. It covers every invertible cold basis and distributed upfront compensation in both the150-instruction local block (15 cold helpers) and the complete3968-instruction scalar encoder (457 cold registers), retaining all632 arbitrary inputs.

Both suffix orientations and literal/coalesced variants are rebuilt, with every native relation, helper final constraint and adapter pin relaxed. The original encoder with its original suffix passes all3352 forward and3168 inverse support checks. Changed suffix contacts, including undoing the temporary basis immediately after the paired natives, remain outside the theorem, as do nonascending paid transports and native-bearing replacements.

Validation at `b16a555e8dbab1ff98416b7899ffc853f77bfaa8`:

- Independent agent derivations and package reviews; registered normal and optimized isolated replays pass with16 corruption controls.
- Full632 sparse inverse identities, separate inverse-column round trips and original-source positive control pass.
- Metadata/source pins, exact committed bytes, full source ancestry and whitespace checks pass.
- Official export integrity and optimized Git-free replay with an empty `PATH` pass. Hosted CI was green on the previous head; the updated head awaits CI.

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/productive-helper-inverse-support
```
